correctness.rationale: Exact decreasing harmonic weights yield finite extrema; harmonic integral inequalities give the 1/n envelopes, moving interval indicators realize every point of the continuous logarithmic lens after arbitrary finite prefixes, and a countable open dense intersection gives generic full joint occupancy. The entropy maximum follows by strict concavity. All n≤15 binary words were checked with rational arithmetic; the all-n and Baire claims follow from the proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Douvropoulos proves arbitrary prescribed simultaneous targets if the convex hull of the alphabet is dense in ambient V, which fails for binary A={0,1}⊂R. Its separate-order density and coarse bounded-alphabet exclusion cannot imply the exact pair domain. The Olsen–West generic extreme oscillation of separate averaging systems neither supplies the universal joint upper/lower envelopes nor identifies co-occurring pairs.

value.rationale: The sharp feasible joint geometry answers a natural question explicitly arising from the nonsharp bounded-alphabet obstruction in Douvropoulos 2012, adds exact finite harmonic extremizers and sharp O(1/n) approximation, and proves a residual full-region phenomenon with an entropy-width phase. Separate maximal oscillation is not enough to predict joint compatibility.
